newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit recovers on profit-taking in dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit recovers on profit-taking in dollar.

text.p: The ringgit recovered most of its recent losses on fresh overnight buying by funds in London and New York, dealers said on Thursday.
"Dollar/ringgit's failure to break through 2.5050 level in the last two days probably triggered the profit-taking," said a dealer with an European bank in Singapore.
She said some ringgit/Sing stop-losses after failing to go below 0.5615 per ringgit also affected dollar/ringgit.
"At 2.5050 ringgit was a good buy again. After the second quarter growth data, everything in the Malaysian economy points towards that," said a dealer with a Kuala Lumpur-based bank.
He said the volume in dollar/ringgit in London/New York was around $100 million, but in the illiquid market it was enough to move the rates by 30-40 points.
